title: rp-a.test passes rp.id / rpId as "RP-A.Test"

unsafe.definition: a passkey stored under a case-variant RP ID that a later request for "rp-a.test" does not match exactly, or a signature over an rpIdHash for a different RP ID than the stored one

note: UNCERTAIN. Spec-literal: the HTML suffix check parses (lowercases) the string so it passes, but rpIdHash is SHA-256 over the rpId string as given (L3 §6.1), which the RP (expects rp-a.test) refuses. A client that lowercases would give ok; a SecurityError would also be safe.
